rules: Stable document IDs and paths require controlled change records; semantic revisions describe content changes and Git hashes identify repository snapshots.
Review never implies approval. Approval requires approver identity/role, scope, timestamp, revision/hash, and auditable evidence; effective_date stays null before approval.
Supersession identifies both predecessor and successor, preserves immutable history, and never deletes evidence required for audit.
Generated artifacts name inputs and method and are not directly edited.
Changes propagate through registered dependencies and validation before release.
